about.title: about us
about.mission: We create real settings where high school students learn by doing: they communicate, plan and deliver projects, supported by mentors and a community that matters.
about.vision: High school students who believe they can change something around them, and know how to do it.
about.noSchools: The list of partner schools will appear here soon.

about.contactMissing: Contact details will appear here soon.

privacy.title: privacy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft text: re_form will replace it with a version approved by a legal adviser before launch.
privacy.dataBody: For accounts: name, email address, school and role. For work in the platform: the projects, files, assessments and messages you create. For the newsletter: only the email address.
privacy.minorsBody: Accounts are only created by the re_form team, with the agreement of the school and parents. There is no public sign-up.
privacy.photosBody: We only publish photos from activities once everyone who appears in them (for minors, their parents) has agreed.
privacy.messagesBody: Direct messages are private. An administrator can read one only when someone reports the conversation, and every such access is logged.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask at any time for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion, by writing to the contact address.
